artifacts.title: DUAL-SURFACE GSLIVE MODEL — BATCH ACCOUNT REPORT vs LIVE BET-HISTORY STREAM
artifacts.subtitle: GSLive Manager Partner 118: #/reports/users (batch) • #/events/bet-history (live) • desk-day window • betTime vs calcTime • `t` cache-buster tick
artifacts.description: Reference model for the two GSLive Partner 118 surfaces and the rule that keeps them from double-counting. The batch surface #/reports/users returns one settled account row per player_[login] per desk day (handle, win/loss, wager count) and is authoritative for booked volume. The live surface #/events/bet-history pushes one event per wager state change, where betTime is the placement wall clock and calcTime is the grade/settle clock, and is authoritative for in-flight exposure and placement velocity. Both are bucketed into the America/Chicago desk day (00:00:00.000-23:59:59.999 CT), joined on (partnerId, login, ticketNumber, betTime), and refreshed with a `t` cache-buster tick (Math.floor(Date.now()/60000)) so a batch re-fetch never serves a stale edge copy and never disturbs the stream.
